title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Subsidy Funding Carried Over to a Client's Continuing Outlet
content:
A client whose Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is settled out at a site may go on holding an unattended micro market with Larkspur Table at that organisation, and the drawable subsidy funding refunded is treated accordingly.

Where the client holds an unattended micro market standing open and the subsidy the client has funded at the market kiosk over the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out reaches the outlet carry-over threshold, the major carry-over share of the drawable subsidy funding refunded is carried over to that market rather than paid back; where the client holds an unattended micro market standing open and that kiosk subsidy funding falls below the outlet carry-over threshold, the minor carry-over share of it is carried over to that market rather than paid back; and where the client holds no unattended micro market standing open, the carry-over share is the nil carry-over share.

*The outlet carry-over threshold.* The outlet carry-over threshold is 26000.00 USD of subsidy funded at the market kiosk over the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out. Kiosk subsidy funding of exactly 26000.00 USD over that window reaches the threshold; 25999.99 USD falls below it.

*The carry-over shares.* The major carry-over share is 75 per cent. The minor carry-over share is 40 per cent. The nil carry-over share is nil, and on it nothing of the drawable subsidy funding refunded is carried over to another outlet.

*The records the band is read from.* Whether an unattended micro market stands open for the client is read from the standing of the market the client holds under the Unattended Micro Market Program, and the kiosk subsidy funding is the subsidy the client has funded at that market kiosk as its ledger entries show it over the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out.

| Client's unattended micro market | Subsidy funded at the market kiosk over those twelve months | Carry-over share |
|---|---|---|
| standing open | reaches 26000.00 USD | the major carry-over share, 75 per cent |
| standing open | falls below 26000.00 USD | the minor carry-over share, 40 per cent |
| none standing open | not material | the nil carry-over share |
